text:
lina (release-eng): Packaging complete for private-installer v1.8.3-hotfix. Artifacts pushed to staging. Need canary during customer's maintenance window tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC. checksums: sha256=abc123def4567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890
sam (packaging): copying manifests to offsite mirror now. cosign signing in 2m. tagging `private-installer:v1.8.3-hotfix`
deploybot: [deploy] canary release created - id=cb-3344, target=10% hosts, window=2024-11-18T02:00:00Z/2024-11-18T03:00:00Z
kai (sre): do we have rollback tag ready? if canary flaps we should revert to `private-installer:v1.8.2-stable`
lina (release-eng): yes, rollback tag prepped and tested locally. rollback command: `kubectl -n redwood set image deploy/private-installer private-installer=private-installer:v1.8.2-stable`
ana (customer-ops): ps: our customer will be running kexec during the window; prefer 30s drain probe to avoid evicting pods mid-kernel switch
ryan (platform): noted. lowering terminationGracePeriod and increasing readinessProbe initialDelay in canary helm values.
sam (packaging): cosign done. signature OID: cosign.sig:sha256:ZZZabczzz...; uploaded signed manifest to s3://private-delivery/3344556677/manifest.json
pkg-liaison: pinged delivery partner for courier ETA and HSM key thumbprint check. they acked
kai (sre): quick checklist before canary: 1) smokes ok on staging 2) cosign sig verified 3) backup registry mirror online 4) rollback tag present
lina (release-eng): smokes green. verify command: `curl -fS http://staging.private/internal/health || exit 1` (passed)
deploybot: [canary-started] cb-3344 started at 2024-11-18T02:00:05Z on 12 hosts. routing=10% traffic
ana (customer-ops): monitoring app logs and kernel logs. will report within first 5m
kai (sre): if error-rate > 1.5% over 5m, we abort and trigger rollback. rollback sequence: 1) deploybot abort canary 2) promote v1.8.2-stable to 100% 3) notify customer
deploybot: [alert] cb-3344 error-rate spike detected (1.9%) at 2024-11-18T02:07:21Z
lina (release-eng): aborting canary now. issuing rollback.
deploybot: [rollback] rollback started. target=private-installer:v1.8.2-stable. eta to stable=3m
ryan (platform): mirror promotion in progress, registry mirror now serving stable tag
pkg-liaison: courier confirmed delivery delay window closed; nothing else needed from ops
ana (customer-ops): customer accepted rollback, confirmed services restored
deploybot: [complete] rollback finished at 2024-11-18T02:12:40Z. cb-3344 closed
lina (release-eng): postmortem: packaging bug in config inflation caused feature-flag off unexpectedly. fixing and will prepare v1.8.3.1, aiming for next maintenance slot
sam (packaging): creating patch branch and new shrinkwrap, will attach release notes and hash diff
kai (sre): add regression test for feature-flag preservation during packaging
lina (release-eng): thanks everyone — I'll open a release-note PR and tag the incident. :thumbsup:
